complete_metadata_scan_from_existing_rep.scope_note: These totals are copied from the existing metadata-only report. They exclude HTML/CSS/JS/XML and CDX/prefix members and are not a complete payload scan.

bounded_name_domain_sample.scope_note: Names and nearby domains are bounded evidence only; context windows can contain both replay and origin URLs. No cookie value is retained.

precise_structured_cookie_sample.scope_note: This second bounded pass parses only structured JSON/.meta members and small header-like samples. It records exact header key names, capture years, and value-shape classifications without storing any cookie value. Unknown means the value was not proven public or deleted.

zip_scope_from_existing_report.scope_note: Central-directory and metadata totals below describe the six ZIPs in the existing publication hygiene report. Any artifact created after that report is listed as outside this review rather than silently treated as scanned.

credential_classification.interpretation: The bounded sample matched response Set-Cookie syntax only; it found no request Cookie syntax. wb-p-SERVER is consistent with Archive playback infrastructure. wb-cdx-SERVER and wb-cdx-nomatch-SERVER are consistent with Archive/CDX responses. JSESSIONID, login.cookies, and perm are session/preference-like names near both Archive and historical official-site domains; their values and exact issuer are not retained, so treat them as ambiguous public replay metadata, not proof of authenticated credentials.

zip_release_scope.full_source_recommendation: Keep WOW_Encyclopedia_20080512_full_source.zip as a separate release asset for the original 437-file source backup.
zip_release_scope.recovery_recommendation: The offline_recovery ZIP contains selected research/evidence members; it is not a complete copy of the workspace research tree.
zip_release_scope.historical_candidate_recommendation: Keep 20101203 and reassessment ZIPs separately labeled as historical candidate evidence, not baseline source.

coverage_limits: No network calls and no member extraction to disk.
This review does not rescan ZIP payloads; nested ZIP payloads and non-metadata members remain outside the existing complete metadata totals.
Several existing metadata ZIP scans reached their 512 MiB/member-error boundary; those are explicitly marked truncated.
A value-free field match cannot prove whether a replay Set-Cookie was anonymous infrastructure state or an origin session cookie.
The runtime ZIP created after the existing six-ZIP report is listed as outside this review and was not included in the 11,345-field total.
